heroHeadline: Day 607: Sheinbaum Delivers Second Government Report 'En Defensa de la Soberanía' at Monumento a la Revolución; USMCA Round 1 Closes Without Deals; CNTE Strike Escalates to June 1 March
heroSubtitle: May 31, 2026 marks Day 607 of Claudia Sheinbaum's presidency. Sheinbaum delivered her second major government accountability report — 'En Defensa de la Soberanía' — live from the National Palace with tens of thousands gathered at the Monumento a la Revolución, broadcast simultaneously to all 32 states. Key figures: 49% homicide reduction since inauguration (86.9→44.3 daily avg), $23.6B Q1 FDI record, labor poverty down 3.2 percentage points, 85 officials arrested. The sovereignty framing was direct — 'Mexico is nobody's colony, nobody's protectorate' — responding to the CIA expulsion (May 28) and Rocha Moya DOJ indictment (Apr 29). USMCA Round 1 concluded May 29 with Ebrard declaring a 'net positive' but no concrete agreements signed; the U.S. demand for 50% U.S.-origin auto content was rejected by Mexico; Round 2 set for June 16–17 in Washington. Also on May 29: the CNTE marched 800 teachers to SEGOB; seven-hour talks failed on core pension and salary demands; June 1 national strike escalation confirmed. On May 30 (Saturday): CNTE Sección 22 (Oaxaca) extraordinary assembly formally voted to join the June 1 national strike, and Morena convoked nationwide mobilization for the May 31 informe.
